fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Foot Points are the most basic infantry formation, deployed on foot without transport. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they are best suited to garrison duty, facility security, and defensive positions where their lack of mobility is less of a liability. Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing the Point with indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
